Our care

How we can help

Treatments

Visit us for checkups, fillings, teeth whitening and dentures. We also provide basic dental care in residential care homes.

Our own dental laboratory

Our treatment team works closely with our dental laboratory. Watch the laboratory video for a look behind the scenes.

Our team

The dentists

Our dentists combine experience with a gentle, attentive approach. Their Portuguese roots bring warm hospitality to the practice.

Our assistants welcome you at reception, keep the practice running smoothly and support you during treatment.

Getting here

Take tram 4 or 10 to Kasteelplein. Bike parking is available in front of the practice. Paid street parking is available nearby; Q-Park Museum is about a five-minute walk away.
